title: Minutes Immutability, Attestation, and Concurrency Workflow

verified_behaviors.rule: PUT /governance/meetings/{meeting}/minutes on an approved minute is strictly rejected and existing content remains unaltered.
PUT /governance/meetings/{meeting}/minutes on a signed minute is strictly rejected and existing content remains unaltered.
Optimistic concurrency version check prevents two-editor race condition. If expected_version does not match current version, 409 Conflict exception is thrown.
Draft updates increment version_number and preserve complete prior version snapshots (including content blocks, SHA-256 fingerprint, and timestamp) in version_history.
signed_by and reviewed_by resolve to board_members.id (not users.id) to preserve foreign key constraints, while accessors report full human-readable attribution.
Replay of minute signing is idempotent; repeated signing returns existing receipt and original signed timestamp without drift.
Attempting to approve an empty minute (no non-empty textual content blocks) throws DomainException.
createCorrection creates a new draft version N+1, resets signed status, and stores full superseded signed snapshot in version_history with reason for correction.
Historical minute records with timestamps but missing foreign keys explicitly report 'Legacy attribution unavailable' instead of empty strings or errors.
